I’m sorry—I don’t have access to live market feeds, so I can’t give you an exact quote for today's U.S. spot gold price.  

For the most accurate and up‑to‑date figure, check one of the following reputable resources:

| Source | How to find it |
|--------|----------------|
| **Bloomberg** (gold section) | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets/gold |
| **Kitco** (spot prices) | https://kitco.com/ |
| **Reuters** (commodities) | https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/commodity-prices |
| **NYMEX / COMEX** (official exchange quotes) | https://www.cmegroup.com/trading/metals/equity.html |

These sites update their spot prices several times per minute during trading hours. If you need historical trends or deeper analytics, many financial platforms offer charts and downloadable data as well.
